query: SELECT strftime(date_trunc('month', date), '%Y-%m') AS month, count(DISTINCT tx_hash) AS txs FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash FROM (SELECT date, tx_hash, script_hash AS h FROM transaction_scripts WHERE date in <year window> UNION ALL SELECT date, tx_hash, owner_payment_credential AS h FROM address_utxo WHERE date >= DATE '2021-09-01' AND date < DATE '2022-01-01') WHERE h IN ('fb43ee22000fb1ffc5e825253375df1bb80d4bacccc106f4ad534f8b', '5a7a6d23f477638474c8db5d37d9f3af8edd4b160806d063add8aeed')) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
